s02075.summary: Wren and Dottie idle the night shift while Hank checks in by radio.
Dottie asks if Wren applied to the Duluth program and teases about her mother.
Wren asks whether everyone would be mad if she skips the Duluth program.
They hit the emergency stop, share the pen, and Dottie leans on Wren's shoulder.
Wren fetches a pop as headlights approach; Dottie turns the car away and returns laughing.

s02086.summary: Madame Adebola-Quinn and her crew bake as dispatch warns of cloud shear.
Inspector Loganathan staggers in for a surprise audit just as the shear nears.
The shear hits, tossing the kitchen; Pietro panics while Madame deadpans and flour falls.
Madame eats a floor-dropped cake and the inspector tastes one and passes them.

s00703.summary: Ostrander steadies himself, reports his depleted company to Battalion and hears orders to hold.

s01763.summary: Trapped survivors take stock; Magda assures them rescue knows they are there.
Bea asks gently about Ximena's baby while Teo plays a tender harmonica tune.
Joaquin frets about his wife; Bea mentions her grandmother waiting at Elm station.
Magda organizes rationing, splitting a granola bar six ways; the group shares it.
As concrete groans, Teo asks Bea to hum and joins her on harmonica.

s00112.summary: Four castaways drift in a lifeboat at dawn, silent and exhausted.
Magnus spots a smoke trail; Delphine and Baz urge firing, but he says wait.
As a ship's hull appears, Magnus orders the flare fired and they scream together.

s00522.summary: Purser Isolde walks the car deck chatting briefly with Rafferty, Jung-Ho and Winnie.
Isolde counts forty-one vehicles against a manifest of forty and finds an unticked van.
She tries the van's locked door; Jung-Ho and Rafferty warn her of its strange engine whine.
A hand sets a black box on the deck as Isolde orders everyone to evacuate.

s01813.summary: Night court arraigns a barefoot man in a hospital gown for trespassing in a shark tank.
Corwin explains he sought a woman who lived in the tank, then recalls his name.
The judge releases him on his own recognizance on condition he stays out of the tank.

s00870.summary: Desmond hosts a joyless mandatory-fun event in a parking garage as employees ignore him.
Absurd bureaucratic squabbles erupt over a safety balloon and a slice of cake.
Staff try to leave, lack the right keys, and drift back to the table.

s01189.summary: Dr. Priya examines a feverish boy in the cinema hospital and orders treatment.
Out of the second antibiotic, Priya honestly tells Theo she does not yet know if his son will live.
She tucks the boy's blanket and whispers to him; then the generator fails.
In darkness Sebastian brings ex-pharmacist Ms. Halloran; Priya trusts her to mix pediatric doses.

s00334.summary: Attorney Cornelia deposes taxidermist Desmond about the animals in his shop.
She reveals a forty-second animal is her client's dead Great Dane, and he panics.

s02050.summary: Kira finds a warm panel from Sector Nine bearing a scratched-out name.
Dmitri orders her to put it back; she refuses.
Inspector Leopoldine arrives, halts the belts and asks for Asante-Volkov by name.

s00594.summary: Gloria and Walter wait in strained silence for news in the hospital.
The doctor calls them in; they gather courage and walk together to the door.

s00573.summary: Goblin Mawdley demands tolls from pilgrims Tamsin and Rook and probes a silent stranger.
The ribs hum as the stranger reveals herself as Zephyrine and condemns Mawdley's tolls.

s01153.summary: Commander Issa and crew debate salvaging a lifeless derelict as the temperature drops.
A looping distress hail from the derelict plays, and Issa decides to board alone.
Jonah emerges from the airlock, claiming he's been stranded fourteen months and the loop isn't his.
Issa sounds the alarm and has the hull link severed, but a light turns toward them.

s02243.summary: Detective Sandhu questions the hotel staff about a dead parrot in the locked aviary.
He reads the tag on the parrot's leg and clears everyone out.

s01380.summary: Walter brings Rhea terrible coffee after the trial and they share a silent moment.
Rhea mourns her teenage client's sentence; Walter reminds her of the victim.
They push cups together; she declines a drink but leaves him to fix the chairs.

s01826.summary: Vinnie counts cash for courier Lorne, who disputes the amount as Marisol watches.
Lorne questions Marisol and demands to know what is in the duffel.
Everyone stands; Darius blocks Lorne, and Marisol draws a hidden pocket weapon.
Lorne leaves with his money; the pocket held a stapler, and they laugh and recount.

s01483.summary: Desta and Kipp reach an oxbow camp that she once lied about.
Kipp finds fresh notches on a tree while Desta urges him to eat and not touch things.
Kipp sees a child's boot and counts a fresh notch in the tally meant for him.

s00477.summary: Guard Deshawn finds sleepless Gilbert in the mattress showroom and demands he leave.
Gilbert wins Deshawn over with name banter and a claim that Brenda approved.
Deshawn sits, recalls his mother's bed, and both lie down and fall asleep.

s00126.summary: Five wary players gather for a late card game on the roller rink floor.
Mouse accuses Slim of cutting twice, and Sato's motives are questioned.
Slim notes the sixth chair for whoever collects and forces Teddy to admit giving away the route.

s00771.summary: Rosalind recognizes the stranger on the ferry bench as Elias after twenty years.
Her grandson Teo appears; Rosalind calls Elias nobody as a deckhand checks in.
Rosalind sits near, not beside him, and sips in silence.

s00692.summary: Agent Fola and Detective Reuben sweep a warehouse and find a dropped key ring.
A stranger who knows Fola's name hints she has a secret in Lagos.
Imelda holds a silenced pistol to Reuben's neck and demands the ledger.
Nikolai says the ledger names everyone present and sows suspicion among them.

s02331.summary: Pilar scores loaves as delivery driver Jonah lingers and brings her a single cherry.
Jonah steps close and they laugh quietly together.
Her landlord enters and complains of a roof leak; a drop falls on a loaf.

s00954.summary: Four townsfolk idle on a saloon roof at sunset, bantering about pie.
They hear thundering hoofbeats and drop behind the parapet as a stampede approaches.
Obadiah points out masked riders with torches; he draws his revolver to face them.
